tldr: Mercury in the 11th house: thinking becomes personal through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
body:
With Mercury in the 11th house, this part of you works through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to the people, audiences, collaborations, and shared futures you choose to belong to.

When this placement is supported, your place in a wider network can feel more meaningful and alive. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, belonging can become performative, or a future plan can outgrow the people attached to it. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around friends, groups, networks, community, hopes, and future plans.
